svg.title: Instrumenting spatial experience
svg.desc: Four distinct strands of Kiarash Taheri’s research-assistant work: methodology, a general multimodal research platform, an independent technical EEG–VR pilot, and applied study development. Conceptual overview; all drawn architectural geometry is schematic, not a client design or an experimental result.
